tools.name: deep_review
tools.description:
Run a governed, bounded multi-model review of one question.

Two model slots answer independently and sealed (neither sees the other's
answer), then each reviews the other, then a deterministic governor
decides whether a further bounded round is affordable and stops the run.
Disagreement is preserved, never averaged away.

Args:
    question: The question to review. Must not be empty.
    stakes: "high" (default) runs the full sealed + cross-review path.
        "low" runs a single provider with no cross-review and returns
        review_depth="single", status PARTIAL.

Returns a governed result including governed_answer, status, dissent,
evidence (model-asserted only), round_count, provider_calls, real token
counts where the provider reported them, elapsed_ms, stop_reason and a
trace. convergence_score is process convergence ONLY -- not confidence,
not correctness probability, not a truth score.
